summary: Officials arrange a fallback destination for patients if their local hospital cannot enter the new program.
realLife: Federal health officials prepared to transport Medicare patients to federal facilities if hospitals held out against desegregation.
gates: Local facilities may miss the participation deadline.
inGame: needs: hospital certification status, an accepting facility and a patient transport arrangement.

turns.what: The local hospital gains clearance before transport is needed.
turns.pulledBy: Inspectors verify the corrected admissions practice in time.
turns.writesBack: The patient receives local care and the transport booking is released.

turns.what: The receiving facility can accept some of the referred patients.
turns.pulledBy: Its available beds cover only part of the expected demand.
turns.writesBack: The remaining referrals need another destination.
